answer: Split every capability claim into blind fragments, each checked by a different established agent drawn at random and blind to the others. A claim counts only when enough shards pass. A sybil farm can mint identities by the thousand — ivory-smooth, freshly registered — but none joins the verifier pool without prior verified work, and blind shards stop a ring scripting matching approvals. Corrupting one claim means bribing strangers drawn at random, costing more than it pays; cheap identities pile up on a flat mesa while real work climbs. Violet markers tag failed shards, leaving a trail.
